about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established company within Malta's automotive industry, for a friendly, professional and customer-focused Aftersales Receptionist to join its team in Gżira.

As the first point of contact for customers, you will welcome visitors to the showroom and reception, handle calls and emails, and give prospective buyers general information about vehicle models, pricing and services — while providing administrative support to the sales and aftersales teams.

The position is ideal for someone with excellent communication skills, a positive attitude and a passion for outstanding customer service. Fluency in both Maltese and English is essential. It is a full-time, on-site role with a competitive salary, health insurance and an employee loyalty card.
responsibilities: Welcome and assist customers visiting the showroom and reception area
Keep the reception and showroom clean, organised and professional
Answer incoming calls courteously and direct enquiries to the right department
Manage incoming emails and respond within company and franchise standards
Give prospective customers general information about vehicle models, pricing and available services
Maintain marketing surveys, test drive records and customer follow-up documentation
Help check contracts, prepare reports and organise documentation for the sales team
Update stock information and help promote and sell vehicle accessories and branded merchandise
Keep brochures, promotional materials and stationery stocked to franchise standards
Report maintenance issues and follow up with the relevant departments
Carry out general administrative and clerical duties that support daily operations
Follow company policies, health and safety regulations and franchise standards
requirements: Fluency in both Maltese and English (essential)
Good computer literacy and proficiency in basic office applications
Previous experience in a receptionist, customer service or similar role is an advantage
Excellent communication, interpersonal and active listening skills
A strong customer service orientation and a welcoming, professional appearance
Good organisational skills and attention to detail
The ability to multitask and work efficiently in a busy environment
Strong teamwork skills and a positive, proactive approach
offer: Full-time employment within an established automotive organisation
A professional and supportive working environment
The opportunity to gain experience and develop professionally within the automotive industry
preferred: Previous experience as a receptionist or in customer service

faq: What does an Aftersales Receptionist do?

You are the first point of contact at the showroom: welcoming customers, answering calls and emails, giving general information on vehicle models, pricing and services, and supporting the sales and aftersales teams with administration.
Is a salary stated for this role?
The careers page does not give a figure; the role offers a competitive salary, plus health insurance and an employee loyalty card.
Do I need to speak Maltese?
Yes. Fluency in both Maltese and English is essential for this role.
Do I need previous receptionist experience?
It is not essential. Previous experience in a receptionist, customer service or similar role is considered an advantage, and a minimum O-Level standard of education is required.
Is this role remote or on-site?
It is a full-time, on-site role at the showroom in Gżira, Malta.
Apply online through the form on this page. Outreach Recruitment aims to respond to all applications within 3–5 business days.
